cancellationPolicies.label: Free Cancellation rates
cancellationPolicies.description: If you cancel your booking before 23:59 18th Nov 2025 (AEST) your deposit will be refunded to your payment card. If you cancel after 23:59 18th Nov 2025 (AEST) or in the event of a no-show, your deposit will not be refunded and the total of the first night's accommodation will be charged to your payment card, unless otherwise stated (see 'Things to Note' information). Please note that cancellations must be made directly within your booking in My Account.

privates.name: Deluxe Double Bed Private Ensuite
privates.description: In order to secure a Private Room, you will need to book the entire room.
privates.labelDescription: Our first floor Private King + Ensuite is the perfect getaway for a couple or with a friend.  Have your own private space but enjoy the vibe of the hostel.  The super comfy King bed splits to twin single. Advise if twin single is required.

paymentProcedure.label: Deposit only

Deposit only
Your deposit will be non-refundable unless the Standard Flexible Booking option is available and you select it. T&C apply.
